translations.web: Praise Yahweh, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.
translations.bsb: Bless the LORD, all His angels mighty in strength who carry out His word, who hearken to the voice of His command.
translations.kjv: Bless the LORD, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.
translations.asv: Bless Jehovah, ye his angels, That are mighty in strength, that fulfil his word, Hearkening unto the voice of his word.
